---
title: "演講"
# Renders the heading over a full-width banner, which is why the page
# body no longer opens with a hand-rolled .column-screen image div.
title-block-banner: ../img/george_sonic_talk.jpg
title-block-banner-color: white
# description-meta, not description: `description` would also print
# verbatim on the banner, under the heading.
description-meta: "George G. Vega Yon 博士在網絡科學、統計計算與科學軟件方面的受邀演講、會議報告與研討會。"
---

```{r}
#| label: fetch-talks
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
# Fetched at render time, so a network failure must not take the build down:
# fall back to a link instead of stopping the render.
src <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gvegayon/talks/refs/heads/master/README.md"
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".md")

ok <- tryCatch(
  download.file(url = src, destfile = tmp, quiet = TRUE) == 0L,
  error = function(e) FALSE,
  warning = function(w) FALSE
)

if (ok) {
  # Removing the header
  readLines(tmp, warn = FALSE) |>
    gsub(pattern = "^# List of talks.+", replacement = "") |>
    cat(sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("现在无法获取演讲列表。请访问 [gvegayon/talks](https://github.com/gvegayon/talks) 查看最新列表。")
}
```
